profile.deleteSummary: Deleting your account permanently removes your sign-in and signs you out. Your sessions, course enrollments and progress, messages, and other records owned by your account are deleted. Your member record, donation history, and giving plan are not deleted; your giving plan is not cancelled automatically, and contact details on retained records may remain. Cancel your giving plan separately before deleting your account. A deletion audit record containing a one-way email hash, your selected reason, and plan information is retained. Uploaded files are deleted where storage removal succeeds; files that a storage provider cannot remove may remain.
profile.deleteLastWarning: By selecting Delete, you confirm that you understand which records remain and that your giving plan must be cancelled separately. Your account cannot be restored after deletion.

aboutPage.storyTitle: Welcome to Global God's Presence Church
aboutPage.storyP1: Global God's Presence Church is a vibrant community of believers dedicated to worship, fellowship, and service. Founded in Mbarara, Uganda, we have grown into a family united by faith and a desire to see God's kingdom come in our city and beyond.
aboutPage.storyP2: Our mission is to spread the love of Christ and make a positive impact in our community and beyond. We offer a variety of programs, events, and resources to support spiritual growth and engagement — both in-person and online.
aboutPage.missionText: To lead people into a growing relationship with Jesus Christ through Spirit-filled worship, Word-based teaching, and whole-life discipleship, so that every person discovers their God-given purpose and lives it out in the world.
aboutPage.visionText: To be a transformative, multigenerational church that reaches every neighbourhood of Mbarara, Uganda and beyond — raising up disciples who carry the presence of God into every sphere of society.

privacyPage.heroDesc: How we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacyPage.intro: Global God's Presence Church ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website or use our services, how we use it, and your rights regarding your data.
privacyPage.section1Text: We may collect personal information you voluntarily provide, including your name, email address, and prayer requests when you submit forms on our website. We also collect non-personal, aggregate information such as browser type, pages visited, and time spent on pages through Cloudflare Web Analytics, a cookieless page-analytics tool that does not track you across other websites.
privacyPage.section2Text: We use the information you provide to respond to your enquiries, send you our newsletter (only with your consent), process prayer requests confidentially, and improve our website and services. We never sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacyPage.section3Text: All prayer requests submitted through our website are kept strictly confidential and are only accessible to our designated prayer team. We take the trust you place in us very seriously.
privacyPage.section4Text: We use a small number of strictly necessary cookies: one keeps you signed in, and one remembers your language preference. We do not use analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies — the page-analytics tool we use, Cloudflare Web Analytics, is cookieless and does not set anything on your device or track you across other sites. If visiting from the EU, EEA, or UK, you'll see a cookie notice on your first visit; your choice is stored for 180 days. You can also control cookies through your browser at any time, though disabling the necessary ones will sign you out and reset your language preference.
privacyPage.section5Text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacyPage.section6Text: Our website may include links to third-party platforms (Facebook, YouTube, etc.). These services have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices.
privacyPage.section7Text: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@globalgodspresencechurch.org.
privacyPage.section8Text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacyPage.contactText: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us:

mtn-momo.name: MTN Mobile Money
mtn-momo.metaDescription: Step-by-step instructions for donating to Global God's Presence Church using MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) from your phone.
mtn-momo.intro: MTN Mobile Money lets you send your gift directly from your phone in a few minutes, without needing a bank account. This is the fastest option for givers in Rwanda.
mtn-momo.introUganda: Send your gift from your MTN Uganda line using MTN Mobile Money.
steps: Dial *182# on your MTN line.
Select "Send Money", then "Send to Mobile Number".
Enter +250783389668 as the recipient number and the amount you wish to give.
In the reference or reason field, write the donation type (e.g. Tithe, Building Fund) and confirm the transaction with your PIN.
stepsUganda: Open MTN Mobile Money on your MTN Uganda phone or dial *165#.
Choose Send Money, then select the option for sending to a mobile money number.
Enter +256 776 747 545 as the recipient and enter your donation amount.
Add your donation type as the reference, check the recipient details, and confirm with your MTN MoMo PIN.
notes: Keep the MTN confirmation SMS as your receipt until we mark your gift as received.
Network charges from MTN may apply depending on your plan.

faq.q: Do I need to be registered with MTN MoMo to give this way?
faq.a: Yes, you need an active MTN Mobile Money account with sufficient balance to send the amount.

faq.q: How long until my donation is confirmed?
faq.a: Our team verifies MoMo gifts against the church account within 1–2 business days and updates your donation history.

airtel-money.name: Airtel Money
airtel-money.metaDescription: How to send a donation to Global God's Presence Church using Airtel Money.
airtel-money.intro: If you use Airtel as your network, you can send your gift directly through Airtel Money using the church's Airtel Money number.
steps: Dial *185# on your Airtel line.
Select "Send Money" and choose "To Airtel Number" or "To Any Network".
Enter [ADD_AIRTEL_MONEY_NUMBER] as the recipient and the amount you wish to give.
Add the donation type as your reference and confirm with your Airtel Money PIN.
notes: Keep your Airtel confirmation message as proof of payment.
Standard Airtel Money transfer fees may apply.

faq.q: Can I use Airtel Money from outside Uganda?
faq.a: Airtel Money works across Airtel's network in East Africa; check with your local Airtel provider for cross-border transfer support.

faq.q: What if I don't have Airtel Money installed?
faq.a: You can use the  USSD code on any basic phone without installing an app.

sendwave.name: Sendwave
sendwave.metaDescription: Instructions for giving to Global God's Presence Church from abroad using the Sendwave app.
sendwave.intro: Sendwave is a popular option for members of our diaspora community who want to send a gift home quickly, using just a phone number and the Sendwave app.
steps: Open the Sendwave app and select Rwanda as the destination country.
Choose "Send to Mobile Money" and enter +250783389668 as the recipient number.
Enter the amount you wish to give and confirm the recipient name matches Umumararungu Margueritte.
Add the donation type in the notes field, if the app allows it, and complete the transfer.
notes: Sendwave typically delivers funds to Rwandan mobile money accounts within minutes.
Screenshot your Sendwave receipt in case we need it to match your gift to your donor record.

faq.q: Which countries can send via Sendwave?
faq.a: Sendwave supports transfers from the US, UK, and several EU countries to Rwanda; check the app for the current list.

faq.q: Are there fees on Sendwave transfers?
faq.a: Sendwave's fees vary by sending country and amount — the app shows the exact fee before you confirm.

western-union.name: Western Union
western-union.metaDescription: How to send a donation to Global God's Presence Church through Western Union, in person or online.
western-union.intro: Western Union is a reliable option if you prefer sending your gift through an agent location or the Western Union website, especially for larger one-time gifts.
steps: Visit westernunion.com or a nearby Western Union agent location.
Choose "Send Money" to Rwanda and select mobile wallet or cash pickup as the delivery method.
Enter the recipient as Umumararungu Margueritte with phone number +250783389668.
Enter your gift amount, note the donation type as the purpose, and complete the transfer with the tracking (MTCN) number.
notes: Save your Western Union tracking number (MTCN) — we may ask for it to confirm your gift.
Fees and delivery times vary by country and payout method.

faq.q: Can I send from the Western Union app?
faq.a: Yes, the mobile app supports the same send-to-mobile-wallet option as the website.

faq.q: How long does a Western Union transfer take to arrive?
faq.a: Most digital transfers to mobile wallets arrive within minutes to a few hours.

moneygram.name: MoneyGram
moneygram.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to donating to Global God's Presence Church via MoneyGram.
moneygram.intro: MoneyGram offers another trusted way to send your gift from abroad, either online or through a local agent, directly to our church's mobile wallet.
steps: Go to moneygram.com or visit a MoneyGram agent near you.
Select Rwanda as the destination and choose mobile wallet transfer.
Enter the recipient as  Umumararungu Margueritte with phone number +250783389668.
Enter the amount, list the donation type as the reason for transfer, and complete the payment.
notes: Keep your MoneyGram reference number as your receipt.
MoneyGram's exchange rate and fees are shown before you confirm the transfer.

faq.q: Is MoneyGram available in my country?
faq.a: MoneyGram operates in most countries — check availability and fees on moneygram.com before sending.

faq.q: Can I pay cash at a MoneyGram agent?
faq.a: Yes, most MoneyGram agent locations accept cash for outgoing international transfers.

im-bank.name: I&M Bank Transfer
im-bank.metaDescription: Bank details and instructions for donating to Global God's Presence Church via I&M Bank Rwanda.
im-bank.intro: For donors banking within Rwanda, a direct transfer to our I&M Bank account is a straightforward way to give, especially for larger or recurring gifts.
steps: Log in to your I&M Bank or other Rwandan bank's mobile or internet banking.
Choose "Bank Transfer" and enter I&M Bank Rwanda, account number 20160241001, account name Umumararungu Margueritte.
Enter the amount you wish to give.
In the reference field, note the donation type (e.g. Tithe, Missions) and confirm the transfer.
notes: Keep your bank's transfer confirmation or receipt for your records.
Transfers between different banks in Rwanda may take up to 1 business day to reflect.

faq.q: Can I transfer from a bank outside Rwanda?
faq.a: International transfers usually require SWIFT details — please contact the church office for those before sending.

faq.q: Is there a minimum amount for bank transfers?
faq.a: No minimum is required; any amount is welcome.

chase-bank.name: Chase Bank (USA) Transfer
chase-bank.metaDescription: How US-based donors can give to Global God's Presence Church via a Chase Bank transfer.
chase-bank.intro: Donors based in the United States can give directly through our Chase Bank account, which avoids international transfer fees on gifts sent within the US banking system.
steps: Log in to your bank's online or mobile banking and select "Send Money" or "External Transfer".
Enter Chase Bank as the recipient bank and account number 2900222608, account name Matabishi Frank Namegabe.
Enter the amount you wish to give.
Add the donation type as the memo or reference and confirm the transfer.
notes: Domestic US transfers to Chase typically post within 1–3 business days.
Keep your bank's confirmation as your receipt.

faq.q: Do I need Chase Bank myself to send this way?
faq.a: No — you can send from any US bank using standard ACH or wire transfer to our Chase account.
Please contact the church office regarding donation receipts for tax purposes in your country.

flutterwave.name: Flutterwave
flutterwave.metaDescription: Give online by card or mobile money to Global God's Presence Church using Flutterwave's secure checkout.
flutterwave.intro: Flutterwave lets you give online using a debit or credit card, or mobile money, through a secure checkout page — useful if you prefer not to use USSD codes or bank transfers.
steps: Go to https://flutterwave.com/donate/jahg3nmqjgrs.
Enter the amount you wish to give and your email address for a receipt.
Choose your preferred payment option: card, mobile money, or bank transfer via Flutterwave.
Complete the secure checkout to finish your donation.
notes: Flutterwave sends an automatic email receipt once your payment succeeds.
Your card details are processed securely by Flutterwave and are never seen by the church.

faq.a: Flutterwave accepts Visa, Mastercard, and several regional card networks.
Yes — Flutterwave is PCI-DSS compliant and handles all card data on its own secure servers.
